verdict.rationale: Crossplane is a headless Kubernetes control plane with declarative APIs aimed at 'humans, automation, and AI systems'. It installs non-interactively via Helm, including a dry-run option. Its official CLI can render and test Composition Functions without a cluster and build or push packages, with version pinning through environment variables, all of which suits CI pipelines. Community users describe running it in GitOps workflows with Flux/ArgoCD. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party CI pipeline guide or examples, and independent hands-on reports of running it in CI.
